findings.rationale: In proposal:9a0a16bfbc735598:industrial-sand-mining, the job dimension statement explicitly claims that the operating job is constructing water-resource projects including dredging and land drainage performed as construction, and asserts that industrial-grade sand extraction and preparation are outside this market. This directly contradicts the NAICS 212322 definition in evidence:9e328ff093fbde11aa54dbae495959a3f54aa666a68dab4a7e974fcd263c9065 (which classifies water-resource construction projects under NAICS 237990 as an explicit cross-reference exclusion) as well as the proposal's own boundary and explicit exclusions. The verifier agreed erroneously, allowing a corrupt operating identity to propagate into the compiler release preview.
